summary: Iteration 267: AI vs Owner Win/Loss Scoreboard fully tested. All 19 tests passed. The winloss endpoint correctly compares owner override rates against Sentinel AI rates captured at submit time and matches against actual booking outcomes.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/rates/grid/submit-to-pms correctly captures ai_rate_at_submit via _compute_ai_rate_for_date helper

GET /api/rates/winloss/{property_id}?lookback_days=N returns complete summary with total_overrides, wins, losses, neutrals, win_rate_pct, revenue_owner, revenue_ai_counterfactual, revenue_lift, biggest_win, biggest_loss
Verdict logic correctly implemented: owner > ai + bookings>0 → win | owner > ai + occ_pct=0 → loss | owner < ai + occ_pct>=50 → neutral | owner < ai + occ_pct<50 → loss
comparisons[] correctly sorted by date desc with all required fields: date, owner_rate, ai_rate, delta_per_night, bookings, occupancy_pct, actual_revenue, ai_counterfactual, revenue_delta, verdict
Naive revenue calc working: actual_revenue = bookings * owner_rate; ai_counterfactual = bookings * ai_rate; revenue_delta = actual - cf
biggest_win correctly identifies largest positive revenue_delta among 'win' verdicts
biggest_loss correctly identifies largest negative revenue_delta among 'loss' verdicts
Auth required (admin/manager only) - 401/403 returned without valid token or with housekeeper role
Records without ai_rate_at_submit (owner_rate <= 0 or ai_rate <= 0) are correctly skipped
lookback_days parameter correctly filters date range
seed_data_creation: Test overrides created for dates 8-30 days ago with various rates (60-250) to verify verdict logic and revenue calculations.
